issues.title: Print 01 · Digital → stencil/proof → physical → RETURN
issues.body:
## Goal
Reify the print/proof mechanisms already present in Cassette Atlas / House OS materials.

## Loop
canonical object/state
→ SVG/PDF plate
→ print/sticker/stencil/template
→ physical placement/use
→ photo/measurement/observation
→ RETURN receipt

## Candidate first fixture
One address strip / route tile / tool label / stencil with:
- stable ID
- scale
- registration
- revision
- source pointer
- manual fallback

## Done when
The physical artifact can be traced back to exact digital source and the observed physical consequence returns to the ledger.
